jobs.title: NOC Engineer (CCNP Certified)
jobs.description:
About Penbrothers

Penbrothers is an HR & remote talent management partner and one of the fastest-growing companies in the Philippines. We provide talented Filipinos with global opportunities in high-growth startups and dynamic companies, from the comfort of their own homes.

**About the Client**

The client is a rapidly growing UK-based technology consultancy focused on network architecture, digital infrastructure, and cloud transformation. With deep expertise in designing and delivering robust, secure, and scalable network solutions, they partner with some of the world’s leading organizations in sectors such as finance, media, and enterprise technology.

**About the Role**

The successful candidate will be monitoring, supporting and implementing changes for our Managed Service customer in the broadcast media. The candidate will be based remotely and will cover UK Days shifts Monday to Friday.

**Work Set-up:** **100% Work from home**

**Work Schedule:** The normal working hours shall be **Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time** **(4:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time)** .

Note: The Employee may occasionally be required to participate in an on-call rota to support out-of-hours changes or operational requirements, as needed. Any adjustments to working hours will be limited to situations where such support is necessary

What You’ll Do (Duties and Responsibilities)

* Working in our Network Operations Centre as a Network Support Engineer.
* Diagnose and solve problems and incidents with limited supervision and within SLAs.
* Monitor ticket queues, multitask, and prioritise work by shifting focus as and when required.
* Troubleshoot system and network problems, ID root cause and escalate when appropriately.
* Implement network changes and service improvements on customer’s equipment as required.
* Work closely with the NOC team to resolve complex problems.
* Administer and maintain customer infrastructure via change control.
* Perform RMAs, software upgrades and patch management, for several vendors.
* Create technical documents, diagrams, and SOPs whilst maintaining the company's knowledge base.
* Administer and maintain end user accounts, permissions, access rights and inventory.
* Support our Services delivery function by generating appropriate reporting.
* Working with other areas of the business to support the deployment of new products or tools.
* Mentoring Junior members of staff

**What You Bring (Skills, Qualifications or Experience)**

* **Certification:** MUST be **CCNP certified** with an ACTIVE certification status.
* Experience of working with and troubleshooting **BGP**
* Hands on experience, **Cisco** & **Palo Alto**
* An excellent communicator both verbally and written
* Minimum 12 months experience within a **2nd line role support role** .
* Understanding of **ITIL best practices** . (ITIL Foundations certification desirable).
* Customer-centric with good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* General Support and Operations background.
* Hands-on experience with **Switches, Routers, Firewalls and Wifi**
* Knowledge and experience of ticketing/incident management systems (e.g ServiceNow, Zendesk, HaloITSM)
* Previous experience in a similar role at an IT Solutions Provider/MSP.
* Demonstrate working under pressure and own initiative
* Flexibility to work in any shift pattern covering nights, weekends (BH) including 24 x 7 is essential
* Hands on experiencing of upgrading Firmware of Switches, Firewalls and Wireless access points

Nice to Have

* Zscaler
* Juniper Mist
* Multicast
* SDWAN
* Broadcast Media

**Our Hiring Process & AI Disclaimer:** We use AI tools to streamline our application process—including an initial conversation with an AI Interviewer. All hiring decisions are made entirely by humans: our Talent Acquisition team guides your full candidate journey and makes all evaluation decisions.

You are welcome to use AI for CV refinement and research, but real-time AI assistance during interviews or skill assessments is strictly prohibited to ensure an authentic evaluation.

Read our full **AI Disclaimer** to learn more

**What You’ll Get**

At Penbrothers, we are obsessed with creating positive employee experiences. Here you’ll find an environment that nurtures learning and provides opportunities for growth. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact on fast-growing startups and dynamic companies.

* Meaningful work & Growth: We take every opportunity to stretch ourselves and deliver an excellent client experience.
* Employee as our biggest asset: We are genuinely invested in our people’s career and welfare.
* Global reach & local impact: Get to work with high-growth startups and dynamic companies from the comfort of your own home.
* Powering global startups: We’ve created 1,400 Filipino jobs that empower global start-ups to focus on growth.

jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Overview:**

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and operational workflows that enable the efficient deployment and management of applications and services in cloud environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of cloud-based systems, while leveraging automation and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Your expertise in cloud platforms, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and DevOps principles will be critical in driving efficient and effective cloud operations.

**Responsibilities:**

Cloud Infrastructure Design and Deployment:

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable cloud-based infrastructure architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools.
* Configure and optimize cloud services such as virtual machines, containers, load balancers, and auto-scaling groups to meet application requirements.
* Collaborate with development teams to establish deployment pipelines and enable continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices.

Automation and Configuration Management:

* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools to streamline deployment, provisioning, and monitoring processes.
* Utilize configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef) to ensure consistency and manage infrastructure configuration changes.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring and logging solutions to enable proactive identification and resolution of operational issues.

System and Application Monitoring:

* Set up and maintain monitoring systems to track infrastructure and application performance metrics, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Respond to system alerts and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, working closely with relevant teams to resolve issues promptly.
* Implement incident response processes and participate in on-call rotations to provide timely support and minimize service disruptions.

Security and Compliance:

* Implement and enforce security best practices, including access control, data encryption, and vulnerability management, in accordance with industry standards and regulations.

Collaboration and Documentation:

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, system administrators, and network engineers, to optimize cloud infrastructure and application performance.
* Document infrastructure configurations, deployment processes, and troubleshooting guides to ensure knowledge sharing and maintain a comprehensive repository of operational procedures.
* Stay up to date with emerging cloud technologies, industry trends, and best practices, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization's infrastructure and operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field or 4+ years of professional experience
* 3+ years of hands-on development experience in an object-oriented programming language or similar.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS **(must have)**, Azure, or Google Cloud, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security.
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation and tool development.
* Understanding of DevOps principles and experience implementing GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in cloud-based environments.
* Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security controls in cloud infrastructure.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef is a plus.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer or Azure DevOps Engineer, are a plus.

jobs.title: IT Network Engineer | BGC, Taguig
jobs.description:
**Role Description**

The IT Network/Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the planning, deployment, operation, and maintenance of the company’s IT infrastructure across offices and distribution centers. This role covers network architecture, servers, storage, data center cabling, CCTV systems, and end-user support, ensuring the stability, security, and efficiency of all IT systems. The role requires strong hands-on technical skills, cross-team coordination, and the ability to respond to critical incidents when needed.

**Qualifications**  
1. A bachelor's degree in information technology, computer/software engineering, or a related field.  
2. Over 5 years of experience in network and desktop maintenance.  
3. Those who hold certifications such as CCNA, HCIA, H3CNE or above are preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

1. Network: Familiar with the configuration and management of network devices such as switches and routers, understand basic cyber security knowledge, possess troubleshooting capabilities, and be aware of the ISO 7-layer and TCP/IP 4-layer architectures.  
2. System: Proficient in managing Windows Server and Linux (such as CentOS, Ubuntu, etc.) operating systems and mastering and configuring RAID arrays.  
3. Desktop: Proficient in troubleshooting common issues with PCs, printers, and software, skilled in installing Windows, understands the working principle of CCTV, and can guide suppliers to complete the deployment and construction of CCTV systems.  
4. Data Center: Understand the process and standards of comprehensive cabling in data centers, be familiar with commonly used equipment in data centers, be familiar with the weak current construction process, distinguish commonly used transmission media, and be able to independently make Category 5 and Category 6 RJ45 connectors.  
5. Strong sense of responsibility, with good communication skills and teamwork spirit.  
6. Able to handle unexpected breakdowns during non-working hours, capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously and working under pressure.

**Responsibilities and Duties**  
1. Select network equipment, plan the network architecture of the distribution center and office.  
2. Guide suppliers to complete the weak current engineering and data center construction of the distribution center.  
3. Assist in formulating and implementing IT operation and maintenance specifications to ensure the security and stability of the company's information systems.  
4. Guide regional IT to rack and unrack network devices and servers and organize and standardize cabinet wiring.  
5. Configure the CCTV system and guide the supplier on construction standards  
6. Resolve desktop malfunctions, address all issues colleagues encounter with their IT systems and software, and provide colleagues with training on cyber security and computer usage.  
7. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve hardware, software, and other network and system issues.  
8. Maintain, configure, and monitor network bandwidth usage and network performance to determine if adjustments are needed

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

J&T Express Philippines is a fast-growing logistics and express delivery company known for its nationwide reach, reliable service, and technology-driven operations. Since entering the Philippine market in 2019, the company has built a strong network of branches and hubs, offering efficient parcel delivery, e-commerce logistics, real-time tracking, and door-to-door pickup services. Committed to speed, convenience, and customer satisfaction, J&T Express helps businesses and individuals connect and deliver across the country with confidence.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Php45,000.00 - Php50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

jobs.title: Power Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our Group Technology and Security team, delivering automation and workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency and enhance user experience across the organisation. Our team develops, supports, and continuously improves business-critical applications and integrations using Microsoft technologies. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, we drive innovation through automation, platform engineering, and AI-enabled capabilities.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

### **What role will you play?**

You will design, develop, support, and enhance business-critical automation and workflow solutions using Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies. Working across Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, and enterprise integrations, you will build scalable solutions that streamline business processes and improve operational outcomes. You will also develop and maintain custom connectors, API integrations, and automation workflows that support key business functions.

  
  

In addition to solution delivery, you will provide Level 3 production support for critical applications and automations, investigating and resolving complex platform, integration, and application issues. You will support release management, testing, and change activities across development and production environments while identifying opportunities to improve platform reliability, governance, and user experience. You will also contribute to AI Builder initiatives, platform standards, and continuous improvement efforts to ensure stable and secure operations.

### **What you offer**

* 3+ years of experience developing, supporting, or enhancing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps and Power Automate
* Strong experience with SharePoint Online, enterprise workflow automation, and business process optimisation
* Hands-on experience developing integrations using REST APIs, JSON, custom connectors, and related integration technologies
* Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and production support experience within enterprise environments
* Experience supporting testing, deployment, release management, platform governance, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Exposure to AI Builder, Power Platform ALM, Power BI, ServiceNow, Coupa, Python, or other enterprise platforms and automation technologies is an advantage.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

### **What we offer**

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* 5 days carers leave of immediate family members on top of annual leave
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Voluntary parental medical insurance plan for married employees
* Wellbeing benefits, sessions and events to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing, including a comprehensive medical and life insurance cover
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

### **About Technology**

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

### **Inclusion at Macquarie**

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.  

We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

new_jobs.title: IT Network Engineer - Corporate Connectivity
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a Network Engineer for Corporate Connectivity team with a strong foundation in networking, wireless design, cloud connectivity, and security, combined with hands‑on experience supporting Windows and Linux operating environments. This role supports modern, hybrid IT ecosystems and works closely with systems, cloud, development and security teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable connectivity.

The ideal candidate understands that networking today intersects with operating systems, identity, automation, and user experience—not just switches and routers.

* + Design, deploy, and support **LAN, WAN, WLAN, and SD‑WAN** environments.
  + Configure and troubleshoot **routing, switching, VLANs, and segmentation.**
  + Manage **IP addressing, DNS, DHCP**, and network performance.
  + Monitor network health, availability, and capacity.
  + Design and maintain **enterprise wireless networks**
  + Conduct:
  + - Predictive, passive, and active wireless site surveys &
    - Capacity planning and RF optimization.
  + Configure and support:
  + - Wireless controllers and access points.
    - WPA2/WPA3, 802.1X, and guest wireless networks
  + Troubleshoot roaming, interference, and coverage issues.
  + Support networking services across **Windows and Linux environments.**
  + **C**ollaborate with systems teams on:
  + - Active Directory / Entra ID integration
    - Linux‑based services and appliances
  + Troubleshoot network‑related issues on:
  + - Windows servers and endpoints
    - Linux servers and cloud workloads
  + Support identity‑aware networking, authentication, and access control.
  + Understand how OS‑level services interact with network infrastructure.
  + Design and support cloud networking in **Azure, AWS, or GCP.**
  + Implement and manage:
  + - Site‑to‑site VPNs
    - Client VPNs
    - ExpressRoute / Direct Connect
  + Support hybrid connectivity between **on‑prem, cloud, Windows, and Linux systems.**
  + Partner with cloud and systems engineers on architecture and resiliency.
  + Implement **Zero‑Trust networking principles.**
  + Configure and support:
  + - Next‑generation firewalls
    - VPN gateways
    - Network Access Control (NAC)
  + Support secure onboarding and offboarding of users and devices.
  + Participate in vulnerability remediation and incident response.
  + Support connectivity for **remote and hybrid users**
  + Optimize network performance for:
  + SaaS platforms (Microsoft 365, Teams, Zoom, etc.)
  + Cloud‑hosted applications.
  + Troubleshoot issues across ISPs, VPNs, wireless, and endpoints.
  + Automate network and system interactions using:
  + - PowerShell (Windows)
    - Python or Bash (Linux)
    - API and Webhook
  + Integrate networking with:
  + - Monitoring platforms
    - Lifecycle and provisioning tools
  Maintain accurate network and systems documentation

  
  
**Requirements**  

* + IT / Computer Science-related degree or certification.
  + Strong experience with:
  + - Routing & Switching
    - Enterprise wireless networking
    - Firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN technologies
  + Working knowledge of:
  + - **Windows Server and Windows client environments**
    - **Linux systems and services**
  + Experience supporting **hybrid and cloud‑integrated environments.**
  + Strong troubleshooting skills across **Layer 1–7**
  + Teaching others about technology, Collaborative problem solving, Researching and learning new technologies.
  Analytical Thinking, Effective oral and written communicator across internal teams and external clients, Knows time management

**Nice‑to‑Have Skills**

* + SD‑WAN platforms (Versa, Netskope, Fortigate)
  + Firewalls (Fortigate, PFsense, rXg, SonicWall, Watchguard, Linux Iptables, Paloalto)
  + Wireless survey tools (Ekahau, AirMagnet)
  + Network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, Datadog, Zabbix)
  + Infrastructure automation.
  + Experience in MSP or large enterprise environments

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* + CCNA / CCNP
  + CWNA / CWDP (Wireless)
  + Azure / AWS certifications
  + Security+ or equivalent
  + Microsoft or Linux certifications (nice‑to‑have)

new_jobs.title: IT Network Engineer | BGC, Taguig
new_jobs.description:
**Role Description**

The IT Network/Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the planning, deployment, operation, and maintenance of the company’s IT infrastructure across offices and distribution centers. This role covers network architecture, servers, storage, data center cabling, CCTV systems, and end-user support, ensuring the stability, security, and efficiency of all IT systems. The role requires strong hands-on technical skills, cross-team coordination, and the ability to respond to critical incidents when needed.

**Qualifications**  
1. A bachelor's degree in information technology, computer/software engineering, or a related field.  
2. Over 5 years of experience in network and desktop maintenance.  
3. Those who hold certifications such as CCNA, HCIA, H3CNE or above are preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

1. Network: Familiar with the configuration and management of network devices such as switches and routers, understand basic cyber security knowledge, possess troubleshooting capabilities, and be aware of the ISO 7-layer and TCP/IP 4-layer architectures.  
2. System: Proficient in managing Windows Server and Linux (such as CentOS, Ubuntu, etc.) operating systems and mastering and configuring RAID arrays.  
3. Desktop: Proficient in troubleshooting common issues with PCs, printers, and software, skilled in installing Windows, understands the working principle of CCTV, and can guide suppliers to complete the deployment and construction of CCTV systems.  
4. Data Center: Understand the process and standards of comprehensive cabling in data centers, be familiar with commonly used equipment in data centers, be familiar with the weak current construction process, distinguish commonly used transmission media, and be able to independently make Category 5 and Category 6 RJ45 connectors.  
5. Strong sense of responsibility, with good communication skills and teamwork spirit.  
6. Able to handle unexpected breakdowns during non-working hours, capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously and working under pressure.

**Responsibilities and Duties**  
1. Select network equipment, plan the network architecture of the distribution center and office.  
2. Guide suppliers to complete the weak current engineering and data center construction of the distribution center.  
3. Assist in formulating and implementing IT operation and maintenance specifications to ensure the security and stability of the company's information systems.  
4. Guide regional IT to rack and unrack network devices and servers and organize and standardize cabinet wiring.  
5. Configure the CCTV system and guide the supplier on construction standards  
6. Resolve desktop malfunctions, address all issues colleagues encounter with their IT systems and software, and provide colleagues with training on cyber security and computer usage.  
7. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve hardware, software, and other network and system issues.  
8. Maintain, configure, and monitor network bandwidth usage and network performance to determine if adjustments are needed

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

J&T Express Philippines is a fast-growing logistics and express delivery company known for its nationwide reach, reliable service, and technology-driven operations. Since entering the Philippine market in 2019, the company has built a strong network of branches and hubs, offering efficient parcel delivery, e-commerce logistics, real-time tracking, and door-to-door pickup services. Committed to speed, convenience, and customer satisfaction, J&T Express helps businesses and individuals connect and deliver across the country with confidence.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Php45,000.00 - Php50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Company Christmas gift
* Company events
* Health insurance
* Paid training
* Pay raise

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Taguig: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* CCNA (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: IT Technical Support Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**1. Deliver effective and timely on-site support.**

* Respond to client dispatches and service tickets for POS, laptops, desktops, printers, self-order kiosks (SOK), CCTV systems, and network devices.
* Ensure client devices operate efficiently by resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues within prescribed SLAs.
* Provide support with urgency, professionalism, and minimal supervision.

**2. Perform process-oriented troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.**

* Follow standard diagnostic procedures for resolving device-level issues (e.g., boot failure, no display, printer errors).
* Address network-related issues (e.g., IP conflicts, no internet, switch/router failure).
* Handle peripheral malfunctions (e.g., cash drawer triggers, card readers, barcode scanners).
* Apply preventive maintenance practices to avoid repeat incidents.
* Escalate complex issues with proper documentation when beyond scope.

**3. Promote efficiency through proactive monitoring, documentation, and reporting.**

* Maintain accurate service records, CSO reports, and site activity logs.
* Submit reports timely and ensure client acknowledgment/sign-off.
* Update relevant databases and internal systems with job ticket status and field updates.

**4. Exhibit professionalism and client sensitivity.**

* Represent the company with proper grooming, courtesy, and a service-oriented mindset.
* Communicate findings and instructions clearly to client personnel, both technical and non-technical.
* Educate clients on basic troubleshooting and proper device usage.

**5. Sustain service excellence and team collaboration.**

* Coordinate effectively with Helpdesk, Dispatch, Logistics, and other internal units to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Assist in new installations and train users on equipment operation when required.
* Participate in monthly team huddles, knowledge-sharing, and best practice alignment.

**6. Utilize company-provided systems and tools responsibly.**

* Operate company-issued laptops, tools, diagnostic software, ticketing systems, and field service apps properly and securely.
* Report any system issues or tool damage immediately to the team lead or asset custodian.
* Keep all assigned devices in good condition and use only for official purposes.

**7. Engage in ongoing learning and development.**

* Attend all scheduled face-to-face and web-based trainings as part of continuous skills upgrading.
* Comply with training attendance and evaluation requirements.
* Apply newly learned skills to actual field scenarios and contribute to team improvement.

**8. Participate in meetings and coaching sessions.**

* Attend all scheduled team meetings, one-on-one sessions, and coaching touchpoints.
* Provide honest feedback during sessions and proactively address areas for improvement.
* Implement coaching points in daily performance and support delivery.

**9. Adapt to mobility and extended work conditions.**

* Be ready to travel to various sites including after-hours or shifting schedules when required.
* Observe all site-specific safety, security, and conduct protocols.
* Display resilience and flexibility in high-pressure environments.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS**

* Graduate of any 2 years or 4 years IT related course
* Open for fresh graduates
* With at least one year of experience in Desktop and IT Onsite Support
* Amenable to work in Pangasinan

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* Opportunities for promotion
* Paid training

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Desktop and IT Onsite Support: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Power Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Join our Group Technology and Security team, delivering automation and workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency and enhance user experience across the organisation. Our team develops, supports, and continuously improves business-critical applications and integrations using Microsoft technologies. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, we drive innovation through automation, platform engineering, and AI-enabled capabilities.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

### **What role will you play?**

You will design, develop, support, and enhance business-critical automation and workflow solutions using Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies. Working across Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, and enterprise integrations, you will build scalable solutions that streamline business processes and improve operational outcomes. You will also develop and maintain custom connectors, API integrations, and automation workflows that support key business functions.

  
  

In addition to solution delivery, you will provide Level 3 production support for critical applications and automations, investigating and resolving complex platform, integration, and application issues. You will support release management, testing, and change activities across development and production environments while identifying opportunities to improve platform reliability, governance, and user experience. You will also contribute to AI Builder initiatives, platform standards, and continuous improvement efforts to ensure stable and secure operations.

### **What you offer**

* 3+ years of experience developing, supporting, or enhancing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps and Power Automate
* Strong experience with SharePoint Online, enterprise workflow automation, and business process optimisation
* Hands-on experience developing integrations using REST APIs, JSON, custom connectors, and related integration technologies
* Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and production support experience within enterprise environments
* Experience supporting testing, deployment, release management, platform governance, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Exposure to AI Builder, Power Platform ALM, Power BI, ServiceNow, Coupa, Python, or other enterprise platforms and automation technologies is an advantage.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

### **What we offer**

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* 5 days carers leave of immediate family members on top of annual leave
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Voluntary parental medical insurance plan for married employees
* Wellbeing benefits, sessions and events to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing, including a comprehensive medical and life insurance cover
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

### **About Technology**

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

### **Inclusion at Macquarie**

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.  

We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.
